issue_228.title: Perf pass #221 may have raised contact deaths
notes: The commit immediately before #221 is 684bac5c itself (parent of 3a910dbe). The existing Player baseline already is that pre-perf sweep, so it was not re-run. 805476ea is #221 (Neon perf) plus #227 (Burn trim + lethal Poison/Bleed) on top of that baseline, so a 684→805 contact delta cannot be blamed on the perf pass alone. A 3a910dbe midpoint sweep would isolate #221; it was not included in this re-baseline.

Cinder Rex contact deaths are unchanged: Easy 21/60 cleared and 39/60 died (all contact-only) on both builds; Normal 0/60 cleared and 60/60 died (all contact-only) on both. Harmful statuses still did not land in Rex fights. The stage-3 entry foyer was mixed (Easy contact deaths 7→12, Normal 41→36) and is not a curated Burn/Stop room.

Easy rooms (480 fights): deaths 93→80 (−13). Contact-only 56→54 (−2, essentially flat). Burn-involved 33→15 (−18), as expected from the Maw/Kite Burn proc trim (16→5 on Easy). Stop-involved 4→11 (+7). No lethal Poison/Bleed. Maw/Kite died/N 69/288→61/288; Maw/Kite contact-only 35→42 (+7). Rooms with no kind 11/14/25: deaths/contact 13→8.

Normal rooms (480 fights): deaths 251→264 (+13). Contact-only 41→98 (+57). Burn-involved 158→102 (−56), again the #227 trim (42→12 on Normal). Stop-involved 52→64 (+12). Lethal Poison/Bleed: 0→5, all with death_chain containing dot_kill and death_kind still burn (last land was Burn; a Poison/Bleed tick took the last HP in mixed-status rooms). Maw/Kite died/N 199/288 (69%)→193/288 (67%), slightly down, but Maw/Kite contact-only 22→66 (+44). Fold Star contact-only 9→25 (+16). Rooms with no kind 11/14/25: contact-only 18→32 (+14).

Verdict on #228: the #227 Burn trim worked (Burn-involved deaths fell on both difficulties; Maw/Kite overall died/N did not rise). Cinder Rex contact is unchanged. Contact-only room deaths did rise sharply on Normal, including in rooms that have no Maw, Kite, or Fold Star, so this is not only Burn deaths being re-labeled as contact after the proc cut. Because this comparison jumps #221 and #227 together, #228 remains open: Normal contact-only is materially higher than the 684bac5c baseline, but this sweep does not prove the perf pass is the cause.

684bac5c.title: Stage 3 death breakdown and Cinder Rex matrix
notes: Official balance_arena.py and balance_rooms.py on 684bac5c (after #217 Burn DoT floor / attack halving, #218, #219 Confusion). This is the Player baseline and the commit immediately before #221 (Neon perf pass).
Arena: 5 heroes × 3 skills (bot, skilled, average) × 4 seeds × boss+entry, Easy and Normal.
Rooms: 80 fixtures per difficulty (incl. Cinder Maw/Kite and Fold Star) × 3 skills × 2 seeds = 480 fights each.
Cinder Rex is the stage 3 colossus (boss_hp_start 240). Burn carriers: Cinder Maw (14), Cinder Kite (25). Stop carrier: Fold Star (11).

death_kind comes from the official room harness (status at death). Arena deaths used death_status_active / death_status_kind; those fields were empty in this sweep because Cinder Rex and foyer slices landed no harmful statuses.

Contact-only means a death with empty/none death_kind and no death_chain. Burn-involved / Stop-involved are overlapping flags (death_kind or chain). Lethal Poison/Bleed is death_kind poison/bleed or a dot_kill chain (not present on this build; Poison/Bleed were not lethal).

805476ea.title: Stage 3 death breakdown and Cinder Rex matrix
notes: Official balance_arena.py and balance_rooms.py on 805476ea (PR #227, current main at the time of the sweep): Cinder Maw/Kite Burn proc trimmed 42/16 → 12/5 (Normal/Easy); Poison and Bleed can take the last half-heart; Burn still floors at 1 HP and still halves ATK. Stop, Rex, and generic hostile proc are unchanged by #227.
Same method as the 684bac5c Player sweep: Arena 5 heroes × 3 skills × 4 seeds × boss+entry, Easy and Normal; rooms 80 fixtures × 3 skills × 2 seeds = 480 fights each.
Cinder Rex is the stage 3 colossus (boss_hp_start 240). Burn carriers: Cinder Maw (14), Cinder Kite (25). Stop carrier: Fold Star (11).

New official chain token on this build: dot_kill (a Poison or Bleed tick took the last HP). dot_pinned_then_hit is still the #217 Burn floor (DoT stops at 1 HP, then a hit finishes the run). stop_then_hit is a Stop proc followed by a hit while frozen.
805476ea is #221 (Neon perf) plus #227 (Burn trim + lethal Poison/Bleed) on top of 684bac5c. A contact-death change versus 684bac5c cannot be attributed to #221 alone.
